title: Film Thickness Measurement - Residue Detection on ATL/LMS IPRO8
subtitle: Post-Planarization Quality Validation for 65nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Thomas Mueller

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the ATL/LMS IPRO8 system to detect and classify Residue defects during post-planarization inspection at the 65nm technology node. The test is conducted at Hsinchu Fab 12 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 200mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Residue defects that are critical to yield at the 65nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the ATL/LMS IPRO8 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: ATL/LMS IPRO8
- Inspection Type: Film Thickness Measurement
- Target Defect: Residue
- Process Step: Post-Planarization
- Wafer Size: 200mm
- Technology Node: 65nm
- Fab Location: Hsinchu Fab 12

This test case applies to all ATL/LMS IPRO8 systems deployed at Hsinchu Fab 12 for post-planarization monitoring in the 65nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: ATL/LMS IPRO8
Software Version: v9.2.528
Recipe: FILM_THICKNESS_MEASUREMENT_65nm_POST_PLANARIZATION
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: Low (102 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.25μm
Edge Exclusion: 5mm
Sampling Plan: 9-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the ATL/LMS IPRO8 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Film Thickness Measurement' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Residue defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 65nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 64 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 91% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.9% for Film Thickness Measurement
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.93 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-04-22
Wafers Tested: 13
Total Defects Found: 2999
Defect Density: 954.61 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 1.2%
Capture Rate: 90.6%
Test Duration: 201 minutes
System Uptime: 98.3%

Result Classification: PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The ATL/LMS IPRO8 demonstrated excellent performance in detecting Residue at the 65nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Edge-zone defect detection showed improved performance compared to previous revision.

e) Recipe portability between systems at this fab was confirmed.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS: No corrective actions required. Test passed all acceptance criteria.
